Headquarters: Remote, California

We are looking for a Chief of Staff–style operator to serve as the President’s right hand and help run, maintain, and continuously evolve the Product, Engineering & Design operating model and cadence. 

This role will turn strategy into a durable execution system. You will own the connective tissue across the President’s leadership cadence: preparing the right inputs, creating clarity on decisions and tradeoffs, ensuring commitments are followed through, surfacing risks early, and improving the operating model as the organization changes. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Finance, People, and your peers in Business Operations, partnering with senior leaders who do not report to you and influencing through judgment, trust, and clarity.

The successful candidate will combine executive judgment, operational rigor, business acumen, comfort with ambiguity, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic questions and the execution details required to make the system work. 

AI fluency is an important part of this role. You will use approved enterprise AI tools, including tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable platforms, to automate repeatable operating work, synthesize information across functions, improve leadership preparation, surface risks and dependencies, and accelerate strategic-initiative delivery.

This role reports to the VP of Operations at Squarespace and is based remotely in California or locally at our New York City headquarters. 

You’ll Get To… 

• Run the President's operating cadence. Own end-to-end orchestration of the leadership rhythm: staff meetings, WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs, finance and portfolio reviews, priority updates, and annual operating-plan inputs. Ensure each ritual has a clear purpose, owner, input, output, decision authority, and downstream cascade.

• Drive decision quality. Synthesize diverse inputs into concise narratives that make priorities, risks, options, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions clear to the President and leadership team. Document decisions in the room, assign owners and deadlines, track commitments, and escalate unresolved issues with context and a proposed path forward.

• Improve execution velocity. Identify alignment and execution risks before they surface as leadership surprises, and facilitate resolution across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Operations, Finance, People, and Business Operations, connecting planning, performance, financial, organizational, and roadmap inputs. Use AI and advanced tooling to make decisions faster and better-informed.

• Evolve the operating model. Treat the operating system as a living thing. Establish health measures such as decision latency, action closure, cascade reach, pre-read quality, participation, recurring issue themes, and use them to assess whether rituals, artifacts, and escalation paths are producing the right outcomes. Recommend and implement changes to cadence, governance, templates, roles, and channels as strategy and priorities evolve, codifying what works so the model is easy for leaders to understand and operate.

• Lead high-priority strategic initiatives. Drive complex, ambiguous, cross-functional work on behalf of the President, from framing and workplan through decision, implementation, and follow-through, including emerging problems that don't yet have a clear owner. Support annual strategy, goals, headcount, and budget processes by connecting them to the department's operating rhythm.

• Represent the President and build transparency. Stand in for the President in meetings, events, and discussions, exercising the remit of the position. Navigate difficult conversations and cross-functional tradeoffs without relying on formal authority. Support two-way access to the President through Town Halls, Roundtables, Office Hours, and written follow-up, using sound judgment about what should be broadly communicated, selectively shared, or handled privately.

• Serve as a trusted thought partner to the President and senior leadership team, offering an independent perspective and respectfully challenging assumptions when needed.

Who We’re Looking For

• Significant experience in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or management consulting

• A track record of owning an operating model, leadership cadence, or portfolio of complex cross-functional initiatives, preferably in tech companies

• Knowledge of the product / software development lifecycle

• Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable approved tools, and experience integrating them into daily workflows to automate repeatable tasks, optimize processes, improve synthesis, and accelerate project delivery.

• Exceptional written communication: you can turn a large volume of input into a concise, decision-ready narrative tailored to the audience

• Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand metrics, forecasts, resource tradeoffs, product or portfolio performance, and organizational implications.

• Strong executive presence and facilitation skills; you can create clarity and momentum in high-stakes or ambiguous settings.

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus, resolve conflict, and push for decisions without formal authority.

• High judgment and discretion when handling sensitive organizational, people, financial, and strategic information.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity, switching between strategic altitude and detailed execution, and taking ownership of problems that cross organizational boundaries.

• A continuous-improvement mindset: you distinguish between process and content, challenge ineffective routines, and make change practical and durable.

• A bias toward action, paired with the judgment to know when to decide, when to seek input, and when to escalate.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 6–12 months, you will:

• Implement a dependable operating rhythm in which leadership forums are well-prepared, decision-oriented, and followed through.

• Improve the quality and consistency of pre-reads, decision logs, action tracking, portfolio updates, and quarterly communications.

• Make it easy to see what changed, what matters now, what decisions are needed, who owns the next step, and where risk is accumulating.

• Establish a small number of reliable AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual preparation and reporting effort, improve the timeliness and quality of leadership inputs, and make follow-through more visible.

• Increase the organization’s ability to reuse knowledge, detect recurring issues, and move from raw information to clear decisions without adding unnecessary process.

• Build strong working relationships and trust with the President and his leaders across the department and company, leading with tact, discretion and respect.

• Help the President and leadership team make faster, clearer, better-informed decisions without adding unnecessary processes or meetings.

• Leave the system more scalable and more resilient than you found it.

Benefits & Perks

• A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision

• Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans

• Fertility and adoption benefits

• Headspace mindfulness app subscription

• Global Employee Assistance Program

• Retirement benefits with employer match

• Flexible paid time off

• 12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave

• Pretax commuter benefit

• Education reimbursement

• Employee donation match to community organizations

• 7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• Dog-friendly workplace

• Free lunch and snacks

• Private rooftop

• Hack week twice per year

US Cash Compensation Range: $178,500 - $350,000 USD

Qualys is looking for a highly analytical, technically strong and business-oriented Marketing Data Analyst to join our Marketing Operations organization in Pune. This role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing Technology, Data and Analytics. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with hands-on experience across CRM, marketing automation, business intelligence and data platforms. The role is designed for someone who can work with data, understand processes, identify business problems, build scalable solutions, automate manual processes, and translate complex data into actionable business insights. The candidate should be proactive and comfortable working closely with global stakeholders, including Campaign Managers, Product Marketing Managers, Sales and Revenue Operations teams. The role will be responsible for providing meaningful marketing data and performance insights, helping stakeholders evaluate campaign effectiveness, ROI and overall business impact, and enabling them to make informed, data-driven decisions. The ability to proactively identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement - and translate them into actionable recommendations - will be critical to success in this role. Key Responsibilities 1. Funnel & Performance Analytics Analyze the end-to-end marketing and sales funnel, including Lead, MQL, SAL/SQL, Opportunity, Pipeline and Revenue stages. Identify funnel conversion rates, bottlenecks, leakage, drop-off points and opportunities for optimization. Analyze pipeline velocity, lead quality, campaign contribution and marketing-sourced / marketing-influenced pipeline. Develop analytical frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing programs and initiatives. Partner with Marketing, Sales and Revenue Operations teams to identify opportunities to improve funnel performance. 2. Marketing Reporting, Dashboards & Insights Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards and reporting frameworks using Tableau, Power BI, Salesforce and other data sources. Develop recurring and ad-hoc reporting for Marketing, Sales and leadership stakeholders. Establish consistent definitions and reporting methodologies for key marketing metrics. Ensure data accuracy, consistency and reconciliation across CRM, marketing automation and BI platforms. Turn complex datasets into clear insights, recommendations and actionable business narratives. 3. Data Analysis, SQL & Data Lake Querying Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze large datasets. Use CQL / data-lake query languages and related query environments to retrieve and analyze marketing datasets. Perform segmentation, cohort analysis, funnel analysis and campaign performance analysis. Combine data from multiple martech systems and data sources to create meaningful business insights. Investigate data discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis and work with technical teams to resolve data issues. Develop reusable queries, datasets and analytical frameworks to reduce manual reporting effort. 4. Salesforce & Martech Systems Work extensively with Salesforce data, including Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Campaigns, Opportunities and related marketing objects. Understand CRM data structures, lifecycle stages, campaign membership, lead routing and funnel progression. Partner with Marketing Operations and Sales / Revenue Operations teams to improve CRM data quality and reporting. Support the design and optimization of marketing processes, workflows and data models. Monitor data integrity and identify opportunities to improve CRM governance. 5. Marketing Technology & Automation Work with marketing automation and Martech platforms such as Adobe Marketo Engage, Salesforce and other platforms. Support integrations and data flows between marketing automation, CRM, enrichment, analytics and other systems. Identify repetitive or manual processes and develop scalable automation solutions. Collaborate with Marketing Operations and IT / Business Systems teams on system enhancements, integrations and troubleshooting. Evaluate new technologies and AI / automation capabilities that can improve marketing efficiency. 6. Campaign, Channel & Market Analytics Measure performance across campaigns, programs, events, webinars, digital channels and other marketing initiatives. Analyze campaign engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution and ROI. Support segmentation and targeting using firmographic, behavioral, engagement and CRM data. Develop insights that help Marketing teams optimize audience targeting, campaign execution and investment. 7. Data Quality & Governance Monitor and improve data quality across Martech .

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you’ll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You’ll be embedded in the Engineering department, working directly with customers as they hit edge cases, digging into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source. You’ll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so that customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you’ll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS), and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.

Some examples of our projects:

  • A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues
  • A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting
  • A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns
  • A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com

What you’ll do
